_doc: The quality ratchet's baseline (scripts/cmux-next/guardrails.py, block `quality ratchet`): per rule and file, the short hashes (site_key) of every existing hit, space-separated. A hit the push's base lacks but this file lists for its file is old debt, not new. Only `guardrails.py --quality-baseline --write` writes it, and a push may only remove sites (rule quality-baseline). Never CI.
